title: Container Report - Week 26
summary:
Container
After some big rate increases at the mid-month point of June, we have seen a quieter week this week across the board of FBX routes. We shall see if Liner companies make further increases at the start of July or if they leave rates unchanged or drop them. The Pacific loop FBX01 (China/East Asia - US West Coast) was up by $89 from the end of last week and is up $2,955 since the start of June, ending the week at $6,180.
